function.name: get_current_weather
function.description: Retrieves the current weather conditions for a specified city and state. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which to get the weather, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA' if State for the city exists. 'City, Country' if State for the city doesn't exist.

unit.description: The unit of temperature for the weather report.

The user wants me to send an email to Mom. I need to ask for confirmation from the user about the content or details? The user says "Can you send to Mom an Email saying we should go out and play if Friday is okay." So they want me to send an email. But I don't have direct email sending capability. According to policy, I cannot pretend to send an email. I can provide a draft. So I should respond with a draft email. Also maybe ask for confirmation. The user didn't specify the email address. So I could ask for the email address or just produce a draft. The policy says I should not claim to send it. So I'll say something like: "Sure, here's a draft. Please confirm the email address and any additional details." That would be safe.

Thus answer: Provide a draft email. Ask for confirmation.
